name: Continuous Maize (Baseline)
description: Monoculture maize baseline; common in cereal production zones but prone to soil nitrogen depletion and pest buildup.

name: Continuous Sorghum (Baseline)
description: Monoculture sorghum baseline; drought-tolerant cereal monoculture common in drier northern districts.

name: Diversified Grain-Legume-Sorghum
description: Balances grain production with a short-duration nitrogen-fixing legume break crop, followed by drought-hardy sorghum.

name: Drought-Resilient Savanna Rotation
description: Engineered for drier savanna zones, alternating deep-rooted drought cereals with groundnut.

name: Soybean Nitrogen Restoration
description: Uses soybean in year 2 to stimulate suicidal germination of Striga weed seeds and replenish soil nitrogen.

name: Short-Duration Sahelian Rotation
description: Short-maturity rotation suited for shortened rainy seasons and marginal rainfall areas.

name: Cash-Food Balanced Rotation
description: Provides high market-value groundnut as a cash crop break between staple food cereals.

name: Double Legume Soil Rebuilding
description: Intensive soil recovery sequence incorporating two successive legume years with high fodder value.
